canonical_project: University of Aveiro Data Center cooling and electrical reinforcement
notes: Diario da Republica public-procurement notice 13991/2026 covers works to reinforce cooling and electrical systems for the University of Aveiro data center in Glória e Vera Cruz, Aveiro, with EU funds and lots for datacenter cooling, dedicated electrical interconnection, generator, and electrical board. Instituto de Telecomunicacoes also identifies a datacenter at its Aveiro facility.
